meta_description:
61K likes, 1,231 comments - foodpharmer on October 21, 2026: "Animal medicine sold to humans in India!

Imagine buying medicine for your child, only to find out that it was actually meant for animals.

In Surat, a medical shop owner was arrested for allegedly repackaging animal medicine into smaller bottles and selling it as human medicine using fake labels.

What makes this even more concerning is that this shop has reportedly been operating for the last 20 years. Just imagine how many fake bottles may have been sold during this time.

Medicines are meant to save lives, not put them at risk. Yet, people are willing to put human lives at risk just to make a profit.

We need stricter action against counterfeit medicines and those responsible for selling them.

Let’s Make India Healthy Again! 🇮🇳

Note: This is not Himalaya’s fault. In fact I feel bad for Himalaya as its products were misused in this case.".
